content.short: 01 is a Solana decentralized exchange offering centralized-exchange features such as cross-margin and futures trading.
content.description: 01 is a decentralized exchange protocol on Solana, backed by Alameda and built on Serum, designed to combine on-chain security with advanced trading features. It aims to deliver a trading experience closer to centralized platforms by offering features such as cross-margin accounts and futures trading. For developers, 01 provides a robust SDK in Rust, TypeScript, and Python to enable faster integration and streamlined development of trading apps and tooling. This combination supports quick deployment and flexible use across diverse projects.
